answer_1.quote: In Tense Inflection (TI), the model is provided with an input in the past tense, and required to generate the same input in the present tense. In Question Formation (QF), the model is required to transform a declarative sentence into a question.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences for tense inflection and question formation; next token predictions for language modeling.

answer_2.quote: For QF, we report first word accuracy of the decoded question, and for TI, we report the fraction of test inputs for which the target verb is correctly inflected. ... To evaluate out-of-distribution generalization, we report perplexity on the Penn TreeBank (PTB; test set.
